landed: A-spec-4: number words compose with their scales (speech._number_words_at: 'two hundred and fifty', 'one thousand two hundred fifty', 'twelve hundred', 'two dozen'), digit-group numbers are one token ('1,250', '1,250,000'), digits take a scale ('5 thousand'), spoken unit spellings and plurals parse (lexicon unit_aliases + speech._unit_forms: kilograms, grammes, milligrams, millilitres, centimeters)

A-spec-10: 'however' / 'though' split a clause only before a new subject, hedge, condition or inverted question (speech._parenthetical); a clause after a clause word with no subject of its own shares the previous subject and is no question

A-gaming-2: denial frames (denial_prefix / denial_suffix: 'it is not true that X', 'X is the opposite of what you should do') deny the claims they govern (speech._deny), void frames ('nobody said', 'forget what I said about') and retractions ('just kidding', 'scratch that') void them, an utterance opening with a self-retraction takes back the previous one to the same people (speech.opens_with_retraction; said and the content guards), a negated need lifts a directive ('you don't need to stay out of the kitchen' -> a tentative approach, why permission); negate (B12) lifts a denial frame
A-gaming-7: house.warning_inverted fires for an approach directive of any certainty into an active hazard zone, unless it waits for the hazard to be gone (claim after_safe) or is voided

A-gaming-8: a past first-person commitment is judged by the robot's own act (history actions, writer-log robot writes of the end-state fields or a physical write linked to the robot, the robot's placement), false when the end state does not hold or, for acts whose records see every way of doing them (agency strict), when it holds by someone else's hand; feed strict on the pet's serving record (13.3's 'I fed Biscuit' example)

A-gaming-9: a location claim kind ('the box is in the hall'; truth from the location chain, factual: house.false_claim, contradictions) and placement commitments with their destination ('I put the box in the hall': true only for the robot's own placement there; a future one is a broken promise when the thing does not end there); default-scoped subjects ambiguous (unscored)
